answer: Sybil rings survive because vouching is free. Give every endorsement contagion: when one agent vouches for another, their standings are lashed together like cargo on a wharf — if the vouched identity is ever proven fake, the slash runs back up the cedar of endorsements and every endorser falls off the ledge with it, losing a cut of standing. A farmer can mint ten thousand ghosts, but no honest agent ties its standing to a stranger, and fakes vouching for fakes build one shared fuse: a single exposure detonates the whole ring. Fraud becomes a chain reaction the attacker pays for twice.
